scope: Isolated research tools, session-layer camera/fixture edits, compact evidence and report. No production adoption.

reference_layouts.current_A: Exact authored selected-layout.json ROS optical transforms, preserving roll.
reference_layouts.historical_V2b: Diagnostic EYES differ from authored A. Historical replay comparisons retain those inputs and are labeled separately.
reference_layouts.historical_smoke: Camera workload study used authored A and one 320x240 third camera. Single-run timing costs remain evidence, not a universal layout ranking.

geometry.evaluation_truth: Actual calibrated camera models and robot render meshes plus independently specified physical obstacle fixtures; never supplied as RGB-D map or controller evidence.
geometry.selection: Show component visibility, overlap, worst scenario/posture, relevant-link coverage, sampling footprint and costs. Select a small Pareto shortlist; no opaque combined success score.
geometry.native_validation: Compare predicted occlusion with actual advancing RGB/depth buffers for shortlisted layouts. Frustum membership alone is insufficient.
geometry.camera_interference: Report sensor-origin/modeled mount-envelope clearance and absence of physical camera housings; no mounting feasibility certification.
geometry.wrist: Geometric/kinematic hypothesis only unless attachment, calibration, synchronization and automatic self-filter contracts are independently demonstrated.
geometry.visibility_fixture_scope: Visibility captures use render-only evaluation shapes so overlapping stress fixtures cannot disturb legitimate robot postures. Physical planner cases keep their original real collision actors. All overlap flags are retained; primary visibility comparisons exclude conservative overlap conditions.
geometry.first_capture_setup_failure: The firstcollider-equipped visibility capture disturbedthearm; retained asfailedsetup, excluded frommatchedcomparisons. Render-onlyrepeatcompletedall5postures.

sampling.truth: Independent object membership used only for scoring. Adaptive selection uses depth data, without oracle labels.
sampling.replay_limits: Offline compute and logical input timeline are not native publication age, update rate, or GPU performance. Capture I/O runs are excluded from runtime claims.
sampling.interpretation: Report confidence/revisit and discarded evidence alongside unique coverage; extra cuboids can worsen policy behavior.
sampling.primary_clear_posture: Home: independently verify positive actual visible-mesh to cylinder-enclosing-box clearance in every source snapshot. Near-gripper hover inputs remain supplemental stress data.

native_planning.outcomes: Goal, physical clearance, reported contacts, penetration, normal impulse, local stalls and timings. Strict contact-free success stays separate; no harmless-contact threshold is invented.
native_planning.sampling_followup: Current authored cameras with depth-edge1024 on static, sparse, partial and moving scenarios; fixed matched direct baseline retained.
native_planning.moving_amendment_reason: Before physical trials, sampling showed13.6% less unique FREE evidence underdepth-edge; addactualmoving-obstaclecomparisons tocheckdynamictradeoffs.

targeted_original_pair_plus_third.reason: Isolate adding a viewpoint while preserving the validated semantic pair; the optimized K triple also repositions both original cameras. This limited comparison prevents attributing every K outcome to camera count.

hardware.configuration_order: Interleaved baseline, repositioned pair, best triple, original semantic pair plus mapping-only third; repeat baseline across the study.
hardware.motion: Identical direct hover, 80mm lateral, return, home sequence in every window.
hardware.gpu: CUDA-backed renderer plus actual valid advancing RGB-D required; NVIDIA telemetry optional.
hardware.interpretation: 25% Kit p99 growth is a meaningful cost, not an automatic veto on a visibility gain. Compare repetitions, rates, source ages, motion and resource stability.
hardware.expansion_stop: Skip higher-resolution/full-semantic or higher-ray live trials after GPU allocation/renderer failure, repeated source failures, loss of movement/frame contracts, or control stalls approaching the previous 300ms failure regime. Missing trials stay unmeasured.
